text:
Maya (Product): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Can leadership confirm the sequence & rough ship windows for three items we discussed: 1) new API latency SLOs + fallback routing 2) Console rollout for the rollout UI + canary controls 3) Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization recommendations). Trying to lock owners so docs and partner comms can move forward.
Jordan (Eng): Short answer: we'll decouple these where possible. API SLO changes: tentative canary start 2024-05-15, monitor for 2 weeks, global roll in June if no regressions. Fallback routing will be staged after canary results.
Dennis (Eng-Platform): +1. Need final perf validation for the 99p and median latency by 2024-05-08. If numbers look good, Dedicated pools can opt in in June.
Priya (GTM): That timeline could work but we have a partner demo week late June — can we lock dates once owners confirm?
Jordan (Eng): Tentative canary is 2024-05-15. I'll put up an RFC this afternoon with gating criteria. If blockers come up we push but will signal quickly.
Sara (Eng-ML): For Optimize: alpha with the analysis tooling and suggestion engine by end of Q2; public beta (with Console UX) in Q3. Core batching/quant rules will be behind feature flags for early customers.
Maya (Product): For Console: will the initial rollout include per-route latency graphs and a model-variant toggle? Need to update screenshots for docs.
Dennis (Eng-Platform): Yes — Console will include per-route histograms, a model-variant toggle, and a fallback-policy editor in the canary UI. UX will be feature-flagged.
Priya (GTM): For release notes and customer comms: please list exact API names, feature-flag names, and opt-in endpoints. I'll coordinate legal for the SLA language.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-api-2024-05-15 -> 2024-05-15T18:00Z
Jordan (Eng): RFC link will be posted here by EOD. Tentative owners: Jordan (eng) for API, Sara (ml) for Optimize, Dennis (platform) for Console infra, Priya (GTM) for partner comms. Maya, could you own docs & release notes?
Maya (Product): I can own docs + release notes. I'll draft a timeline doc and attach screenshots once the UX checks in.
Priya (GTM): :thumbsup: If owners confirm the schedule I'll block resources for the partner demo and adjust comms calendar.
Dennis (Eng-Platform): Action items recap: Dennis -> perf report by 2024-05-08; Jordan -> RFC by EOD; Sara -> Optimize alpha roadmap by 2024-06-01; Maya -> docs + release notes timeline by 2024-05-10.
Maya (Product): Thanks — can we reconvene next Tuesday 11:00am PT to sign off on the canary gate?
Jordan (Eng): Works for me.
Sara (Eng-ML): Works.
Priya (GTM): I'll be there.
Maya (Product): I'll create the calendar invite and post the timeline doc once it's up.
